dailyQueue.title: Mobile viewport meta tag is missing

dailyQueue.title: HTML title is missing
dailyQueue.detail: The primary document has no meaningful <title>, so search engines and browser tabs lack the page’s primary identity.

dailyQueue.title: No clear primary CTA was detected

issues.detail: Quality gate caps the project at 89/100 until resolved.

issues.title: Meta description is missing
issues.detail: No meta description was found for the primary page, leaving search engines to construct an uncontrolled snippet.
issues.recommendation: Add a specific description summarizing the offer and value proposition for this page.

issues.title: Structured data is missing
issues.detail: No JSON-LD structured data was detected on the primary page.
issues.recommendation: Add only schema that matches visible content, such as Organization/LocalBusiness/Product/RealEstateAgent/Restaurant where applicable.
issues.expected: Relevant valid schema for the business/page type

issues.title: Canonical URL is missing
issues.detail: The primary page does not declare its preferred canonical URL.
issues.recommendation: Add a canonical tag pointing to the preferred absolute URL for this page.
issues.expected: Self-referencing canonical on the primary URL

issues.title: Multiple H1 headings detected
issues.detail: The page contains 0 H1 elements. The benchmark expects one clear primary heading for the page.
issues.recommendation: Keep one page-level H1 and demote secondary section headings to H2/H3 according to hierarchy.

issues.title: sitemap.xml is unavailable
issues.detail: The benchmark could not retrieve /sitemap.xml successfully.
issues.evidence: GET /sitemap.xml did not return a successful response.
issues.recommendation: Generate and publish an XML sitemap containing canonical indexable URLs, then reference it in robots.txt.

issues.title: robots.txt is unavailable
issues.detail: The site did not return a successful /robots.txt response.
issues.evidence: GET /robots.txt did not return a successful response.
issues.recommendation: Publish a valid robots.txt and reference the sitemap when appropriate.

issues.title: Content Security Policy is missing
issues.detail: No Content-Security-Policy response header was detected, reducing browser-side protection against unintended script/content execution.
issues.recommendation: Introduce a report-only CSP first, inventory required origins, then enforce a least-permissive policy without breaking legitimate assets.
issues.expected: A tested CSP appropriate to the application

issues.title: Document language is not declared
issues.detail: The <html> element has no lang attribute, making pronunciation and language handling less reliable for assistive technology and search engines.
issues.recommendation: Set the html lang attribute to the primary page language, and update it correctly on localized versions.

issues.recommendation: Link the current privacy policy from an appropriate persistent location such as the footer and relevant forms.

issues.title: Legal/terms/cookies link was not detected

issues.evidence: No anchor matching legal/terms/cookies was detected.
